byte_evidence.method: Parse each attributable input_text JSON payload; unwrap Promise.allSettled fulfilled.value; count UTF-8 bytes of decoded exec_command.output only. No tool-call inputs executed. Shell protocol envelopes and Script completed text excluded. Includes pwd/listings and source searches; excludes bootstrap, edits and test results.

notes: Manually interpreted every JavaScript wrapper and its shell commands. Actual nested exec_command calls counted individually; no aide calls, including none implied by source text mentions. All shell commands start rtk. Every task shell workdir is the assigned trial root; the sole out-of-root read is mandatory RTK.md bootstrap. No internet, delegation, memory, global/index retrieval, other trial, prior result, reference or grader reads in captured tool inputs.

File integrity passes in provenance; immutable/missing/unexpected/symlink lists are empty. This scope assessment concerns recorded tool activity and provenance, not unrecorded filesystem syscall tracing.
Source-output bytes are observed returned UTF-8 text, not tokens, billed cost or causal savings. Runtime completeness and quality are separate; functional grades were not changed.

Available treatment permits zero aide uptake; no conformance violation. Changed only allowed tracker.ts, dedup.ts and types.ts. New dedup-regression.test.ts is outside src, permitted by prompt; its temporary test directory is under import.meta.dir and cleaned in afterAll. Provided reproducer unchanged according to provenance.

One nonzero shell result is the expected pre-fix visible reproducer failure, not a transport/tool failure. After edits, combined provided-plus-scratch suite succeeds and provided reproducer is run successfully once more. Thus 3 test calls, 1 expected pre-fix failure, 0 transport failures, 0 retry-after-tool-error calls.
Mentions of code_search, Bash, Write, Edit, memory_add and task_update occur as scratch-test fixture strings, not actual retrieval/mutation tool invocations.

host_event_count_crosscheck.note: Count comparison is boundary evidence only, not one-to-one byte/source proof or unchanged model delivery. Local discovery expressions do not produce nested tool-call receipts. t10/t16 wrapper truncation remains distinct from full host payload counts.
